notes.title: Dev Diary #20 - It's All in the Name
notes.content:
[p][b][i]\[RECOVERED TRANSMISSION: ORPHEUS-AUD.17][/i][/b]
[i][b]Timestamp:[/b] 04:[/i]12:37[b] // Location: [/b]Primary Habitat Deck[b] // Speaker: [/b]Unknown[/p][p]\[/i]\[/p][/p][quote][p]“The red emergency strips barely light the corridor… but I can still hear it. Not footsteps... something else.
Low, pulsing, almost like a heartbeat carried through the hull.
Sometimes it fades, like it’s retreating. Other times, it swells until it’s right behind me… even when nothing’s there.[/p][p]The others think I’m imagining it. Maybe I am. But there’s a rhythm to it… a pattern. Like the ship itself is trying to warn us… or mourn us.”[/p][/quote][p][/p][h2]Naming Doom: The Journey to [i]Moros Protocol[/i][/h2][p]As we enter the final week before launch, we wanted to take a step back and reflect on the journey that got us here. Today’s dev diary is about something deceptively simple… but hugely important: [b]how this game got its name.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/d86700b2fa3c3a37be47546b632dbec9120a7273.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Wasn't there another name?[/b][/h3][p]For the long-time followers, you might remember that we first announced this project as [b]Darkverse: Rogue[/b], tying it to an earlier prototype of ours. But there were a few issues:[/p][list][*][p][b]Too crowded:[/b] “Darkverse” already existed in other media (books, mobile games), making it harder to find us online.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Too familiar:[/b] The “:Rogue” subtitle made it sound like a sequel, when in reality we wanted to build something entirely new.[/p][/*][/list][p]In short, it didn’t feel right. So… the hunt for a new name began.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]The Whiteboard Saga[/b][/h3][p]Working with our publishing partner [b]Super Rare Originals[/b], we went through dozens of options (see the picture above of our workshop whiteboard). The core questions were:[/p][list][*][p]What is this game [i]really[/i] about at its heart?[/p][/*][*][p]How can the name reflect the lore and atmosphere of a lone ship adrift in space?[/p][/*][/list][p]This eventually led us down a very Greek path.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/4886f7e89f3c5f6b7c44927a555a661bcb34e342.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Enter: Mythology[/b][/h3][p]Our team is based in Athens, and some of us are hopeless mythology nerds. It felt right to explore that heritage.[/p][p]We started with ship names: [b]Nyx[/b], the goddess of night, caught our attention. From there, we dug into her connections - her children, her consort, her role in the primordial void.[/p][p]Some contenders:[/p][list][*][p][i]Primordial[/i] (already taken)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Erebus Rising[/i] (cool, but cliché and unavailable)[/p][/*][/list][p]Then we stumbled upon [b]Moros[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Who is Moros?[/b][/h3][p]In Greek mythology, Moros is the [b]personification of doom[/b], the inescapable force driving all mortals toward their fate.[/p][p]For a game with roots in intense metal music, chaotic combat, and cosmic dread, it was perfect. Doom meeting doom. The cycle of destruction written into a single name.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Why “Protocol”?[/b][/h3][p]Moros on its own was strong, but we needed something that grounded it in the sci-fi setting. “Protocol” emerged naturally, it had already shown up in earlier brainstorming sessions, and thematically, it fit like a glove.[/p][p]The ship could [i]initiate the Moros Protocol[/i], a last defense against inevitable annihilation and... doom.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Doom vs Doom[/b][/h3][p]And so it clicked: [b]Moros Protocol.[/b][/p][p]A title that, for us, embodies both the lore and the feeling of the game; where doom itself is met head-on, resisted with every last ounce of strength.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for reading about how we named the game, we hope this gives a little bit more insight into our process and inspirations. We've very excited to be launching onto Steam next week, Thursday 18th September, and we hope to see you onboard the [i]Orpheus[/i], fighting your way through rooms of [i]Darkphage[/i]![/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in the stars 💫[/b]
- Pixel Reign 🚀[/p][p][/p][h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]

notes.title: Dev Diary #19 - Moros Goes Metal
notes.content:
[p][b][i]\[RECOVERED TRANSMISSION: ORPHEUS-AUD.17][/i][/b]
[i][b]Timestamp:[/b] 04:[/i]12:37[b] // Location: [/b]Primary Habitat Deck[b] // Speaker: [/b]Unknown[/i][/p][quote][p]“The red emergency strips barely light the corridor… but I can still hear it. Not footsteps... something else.
Low, pulsing, almost like a heartbeat carried through the hull.
Sometimes it fades, like it’s retreating. Other times, it swells until it’s right behind me… even when nothing’s there.[/p][p]The others think I’m imagining it. Maybe I am. But there’s a rhythm to it… a pattern. Like the ship itself is trying to warn us… or mourn us.”[/p][/quote][p][/p][p]This week, we’re hearing from [b]Vicky Fysika[/b], [i]Pixel Reign[/i]’s co-founder and composer, about how she shapes the music of [i]Moros Protocol[/i], and the inspirations behind its soundscape.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/94e0f1fc1aa0b703436794d9500ba182cf82cc07.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]1. What inspires you when you’re composing tracks for Moros Protocol?[/b][/h3][p]The space/sci-fi theme has always been my favorite. It’s a universe I love to immerse myself in. I often draw inspiration directly from the game itself; its atmosphere, its story, and the world we’re building.[/p][p]I was also influenced by iconic sci-fi films like [i]Alien[/i], [i]Blade Runner[/i], [i]Tron[/i], [i]Star Wars[/i], and others that shaped my imagination. Their soundscapes and moods left a deep imprint on how I approach the game’s soundtrack.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]2. Can you describe where you start when creating music for specific moments in the game?[/b][/h3][p]For action tracks, especially battle themes, I usually start with the rhythm. The beat helps me capture the intensity and energy right away.[/p][p]For atmospheric pieces, I begin with drones and ambient pads, layering textures to create a sense of space and tension.[/p][p]Boss music is a different beast: I focus heavily on strong, memorable melodies, using distinctive sounds that stick with you even after you’ve stopped playing.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]3. What’s your favorite track so far, and why?[/b][/h3][p]That would be the game’s main theme. It encapsulates the mystery, intensity, and emotional weight of [i]Moros Protocol[/i].[/p][p]I started writing it around the time composer Vangelis passed away. He was a huge inspiration to me, so in many ways, it became a tribute to him as well.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]4. What made you want to get into composition?[/b][/h3][p]When I was a kid playing [i]Super Mario[/i], I remember wondering, [i]Who creates the music I’m hearing right now?[/i] I knew immediately: [i]That’s what I want to do when I grow up.[/i][/p][p]I started piano lessons early and began composing soon after. By high school, I wanted to be a rock singer and start a band... which I did, and I’m still the lead singer today.[/p][p]Later, while at university, I discovered [i]The Longest Journey[/i]. Its atmosphere and soundtrack reignited my childhood dream. That was the moment I knew I wanted to create music for video games.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]5. What do you want players to feel when they hear your music in-game?[/b][/h3][p]I want them to fully immerse themselves in [i]Moros Protocol[/i]’s dark, layered world. The soundtrack shifts between mysterious ambience, tension, high-energy action, and epic emotional moments.[/p][p]It’s a mix of electronic textures, metal and goth influences, atmospheric pieces, drum & bass, and more! Something for every mood and moment in the story. My hope is that the music helps players connect more deeply with the protagonist and the characters they encounter.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]6. Any advice for aspiring game composers?[/b][/h3][p]Video games are a magical medium. Composing for them lets you explore the wildest ideas, even ones that seem unrelated at first.[/p][p]Game music tells the story, breathes life into the world, and stays with players long after they’ve finished playing. My advice? Experiment, push boundaries, and never stop creating. Not everyone will like your work and that’s okay. Art is subjective. The most important thing is to stay true to your own creative voice.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/ad14517b91fbaf56d6bb68bc85b36696836ebd0a.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for reading about Vicky’s process and inspirations. Next week, we’ll return with another deep dive into the making of [i]Moros Protocol. [/i]Until then… keep listening. You never know what you might hear in the dark.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in the stars 💫[/b]
- Pixel Reign 🚀[/p][p][/p][h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]

notes.title: Dev Diary #18 - Pixel-Painted Art Style
notes.content:
[p][b][i]\[RECORDING: ORPHEUS-LOG.4123-7: TRANSCRIBED][/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]"…we're down to emergency power. Life support is holding, barely. Hallway lights are dead, just those strip lights along the floor now, pulsing like a heartbeat. I don’t know if that’s comforting or just cruel."[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]"I saw something in Hab Deck 2... hiding, crouched under the bulkhead, hunched over one of the maintenance crew. Its body was... wrong. Not just in shape but also in the way it caught the light. Like it wasn’t reflecting correctly. Like the shadows didn’t agree on where it was."[/i][/b][/p][p][i][b]"I couldn’t make out a face. Just movement... jerky, non-human. Every time I blinked, it was somewhere new."[/b][/i][/p][p][b][i]"If you're hearing this… don't come looking. It's too late for us, for me. Destroy it before it..."[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]\[TRANSMISSION END][/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This week, [i]Pixel Reign[/i]'s Project Lead is taking over the dev diary to share some insights into what makes [i]Moros Protocol[/i]’[i]s[/i] visual style stand out. From retro pixel inspirations to custom rendering tricks, here’s how they brought our world to life...[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Inspiration[/b][/h3][p]A lot of people look at [i]Moros Protocol[/i] and say, “Oh, it’s like DOOM!” But actually our visual foundation goes back further to the 16-bit pixel art era.[/p][p]I spent years working with pixel art in game development, and I’ve always been fascinated by how a few well-placed pixels can suggest complex shapes, lighting, and motion. It’s all about illusion and technique, especially the shading methods artists used to imply depth and texture.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/e155267d6fe2010b496ada0c55d6e71c46a5c30b.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Old Tricks, New Tech[/b][/h3][p]Once I knew the look we wanted, the challenge became how to achieve it in a modern engine without losing that hand-crafted feel.[/p][p]To do that, I rewrote Unity’s deferred renderer, modified the GBuffer, and created custom shaders that simulate the old pixel art shading techniques using real-time lighting.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/3b5141087571d058815f57af6feb20f003c23454.png"][/img][/p][p]1: Unlit texture.  2: Traditional lighting.  3: Final result.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Low-Poly, High-Intent[/b][/h3][p]We wanted a visual style that felt grounded and stylized, but not “blocky” like voxel-based games. So we targeted an early 2000s polygon count for our 3D models: low-poly enough to feel stylized, but detailed enough to support modern lighting and animation.[/p][p]Textures are kept at a constant pixel density across the board. In fact, our pipeline uses more texture layers than most conventional 3D shaders.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The "Pixelizer" Shader[/b][/h3][p]One of our key tools is a custom shader we call the [i]Pixelizer[/i]. It uses a special texture built with diffusion techniques taken from classic pixel painting.[/p][p]This texture allows our lighting to behave the way pixel artists used to simulate with color ramps and dithering, giving smooth shading without losing the stylized look.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/7f9ea6ea2f7521b5330e379ff865e608523997f6.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for reading. We’ll be back next week with another behind-the-scenes look at [i]Moros Protocol[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in the stars 💫[/b]

notes.title: Dev Diary #17 - BioBoost
notes.content:
[p][i][b]\[ARCHIVAL RECORDS – Intergalactic Inquiry into Human Enhancement Ethics, File 7R-73/19X207 - REDACTED FOR PUBLIC CIRCULATION][/b][/i][/p][p][i]“The BioBoost system was never meant for mass deployment. It was a controlled program...measured, evaluated, regulated. Yes, it used ███████ material, but in trace amounts. We had psychic screenings. We had safeguards. The side effects were manageable. It was never meant to be used like this.[/i] [i]We'd never expected test subjects to became less ███████ with each advancement.”[/i][/p][p][b][i]- Dr. P Ilias, former lead researcher, Acantha X Biogenetics Division[/i][/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][p]One of the most crucial parts of [i]Moros Protocol[/i] isn't the shooting and stabbing, it's what happens when you've lost the fight! Players have the opportunity to upgrade themselves with BioMats that they collected during their previous run. This upgrade system is called BioBoost, designed at making you more formidable with every death. Let's learn a little more about it now...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/cb43eb523a05f8f6fc05477d307454e67a9315ed.png"][/img][/p][h3]What is BioBoost?[/h3][p]The [b]BioBoost system[/b] is a high-tier genetic enhancement program developed by [b]Acantha X[/b] to make their soldiers tougher, faster, and more adaptable. Traditionally, upgrades were handed out based on [b]rank and combat performance[/b], awarded only to the most loyal operatives.[/p][p]In-game, BioBoosts enhancements are strong, more aggressive… and powered by a mysterious new resource: [b]BioMats[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3]How It Works[/h3][p]Each time you’re defeated, you’ll restart at the beginning of the current act. But you won’t go back empty-handed.[/p][p]Using the [b]BioMats[/b] you collected during your run, you can unlock [b]permanent upgrades[/b] via the BioBoost system—letting you carry forward progress between attempts. These upgrades make you more effective with every attempt, letting you push further and survive longer.[/p][p]No two deaths are wasted. Every run brings you closer to perfection.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/246d4dff736fb9793d5313234027346797b1aaff.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What Kind of Upgrades Can You Expect?[/h3][p]BioBoost upgrades are designed to be [b]passive enhancements[/b], they won’t change your gameplay style outright (that’s what weapons and augments are for), but they will make you stronger, more durable, and more prepared.[/p][p]Expect improvements like:[/p][list][*][p]Increased [b]max health[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Higher [b]stamina regen[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Faster [b]resource collection[/b][/p][/*][*][p]And more...[/p][/*][/list][p]Each boost is subtle, but together they shape you into something... a little more than human.[/p][p][/p][h3]How Do You Get BioMats?[/h3][p][b]BioMats[/b] are rare biological materials scattered throughout the ship—found in chests, dropped by enemies, and hidden in high-risk areas. They’re highly valuable and absolutely essential for unlocking BioBoost upgrades.[/p][p]In the lore, they’re fragments of genetic material drawn from the same source that caused the [i]Orpheus[/i]’s infection. What exactly that means… well, that’s for you to uncover.[/p][p]But one thing is certain: [b]with every upgrade, you feel just a little less human.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/88de1c6375e286309135f68a2b2ebed2ca01c753.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be back next week with another dev breakdown. In the meantime, [url="https://discord.gg/srct46r9uv"]join our Discord[/url] to chat lore, drop feedback, and stay up to date with the road to launch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]See you in the stars 💫[/b]
- Pixel Reign 🚀[/p][p][/p][h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2][h2][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/"][/dynamiclink][/h2]

notes.title: Dev Diary #16 - Resources and Pickups
notes.content:
[h3][i][b]Invest in Victory with Utopia Credits![/b][/i][/h3][p][i][b]Attention Citizens![/b][/i][/p][p][i][b]Save up your Utopia Credits and purchase a brand-new Acantha Weapon today! From shock-hammers to sharp sabers, Acantha X’s arsenal is certified war-ready and stylish enough to turn heads on any battlefield.[/b][/i][/p][p][i][b]Why settle for surviving… when you can dominate?[/b][/i][/p][h3][i][b]Acantha X: Crafting a better tomorrow, through superior firepower today.[/b][/i][/h3][p][i][b][strike]WARNING:[/strike][/b][/i][/p][p][i][b][strike]Utopia Credits are not eligible for exchange, refund, or conversion into:[/strike][/b][/i][/p][p][b][i][strike]Meal tokens, sanitation passes, access to entertainment channels, interstellar travel clearance, legal representation, Cryo-sleep pod upgrades.[/strike][/i][/b][/p][p][i][b][strike]Misuse of Utopia Credits may result in biometric penalties or disciplinary orbital reassignment.[/strike][/b][/i][/p][p][i][b][strike]Always read your Galactic Exchange Compliance Terms™.[/strike][/b][/i][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][p]With [b]Version 1.0 only seven weeks away[/b], it’s time for a closer look at the [b]core gameplay systems[/b] that power your survival and progression aboard the [i]Orpheus[/i]. Let’s break down your main objectives, combat tools, and the resources you’ll rely on run after run.[/p][p][/p][h2]GOALS[/h2][p]The ship is infected and the systems are breaking down. You're the last line of defense.[/p][p]Your mission: travel deep into the ship to reactivate critical systems and stop the infection before it consumes everything. With ODY-6 lighting your way, explore quarantined sectors, eliminate hostile threats, and lift lockdowns to proceed. Once you find the ship's internal transport bays, you choose your path forward and continue. Be sure to check which path you take, as some may lead to valuable resources or drop you into even deadlier encounters.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/aa4a4c32b0cd54c4a50cd09feabc48693047fbc3.png"][/img][/p][h2]WEAPONS AND AUGMENTS[/h2][p]In [i]Moros Protocol[/i], you’ll carry [b]one melee weapon[/b] and [b]two ranged weapons[/b] at a time. Weapons fall into [b]three categories[/b]: [b]melee[/b], [b]energy[/b], and [b]physical[/b]. [b]Melee[/b] uses [b]stamina[/b]. [b]Ranged weapons[/b] rely on either [b]energy[/b] or [b]physical ammo[/b], depending on the type.[/p][p]Each weapon has its own [b]level[/b] and [b]rarity[/b]. You can [b]upgrade levels[/b] at vendors you find along your journey, but [b]rarity is locked in[/b]. That makes [b]high-rarity drops[/b] especially valuable—they hit harder and often come with unique traits.[/p][p][b]Augments[/b] are where you shape your playstyle. Some are simple stat boosts like [b]extra health[/b] or [b]movement speed[/b]. Others [b]change the way you fight[/b], like giving you a [b]double jump[/b] or modifying how your weapon behaves in combat.[/p][p]We’ve also added [b]Implanted Augments[/b]. These are [b]stronger than regular augments[/b], but they come with a cost. They might [b]increase your damage[/b] but [b]reduce your defense[/b], or give you [b]speed[/b] while [b]draining stamina[/b] faster. Once implanted, they [b]can’t be removed[/b] for the rest of the run.[/p][p][b]Pick your tools[/b], [b]build your loadout[/b], and [b]adapt to survive[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/a142a768179d4b0595c0def2ec2dbf2441779018.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]RESOURCES[/h2][p]You’ll gather five core resources as you fight and explore, each helping you progress, unlock content or improve your build.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/4a346d13c18276e91033585e7575730eca9c4d3c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Resource List:[/b][/p][p][b]BioMats[/b] – Used to upgrade your BioBoost[/p][p][b]Energy Ammo[/b] – Powers blue energy weapons[/p][p][b]Physical Ammo[/b] – Powers orange physical weapons[/p][p][b]Door Keys[/b] – Opens locked sectors, vendor rooms, and loot chests[/p][p][b]Utopia Credits[/b] – Used to buy weapons, upgrades, and augments[/p][p]Break crates, loot chests, and defeat enemies to collect more. Or... just hope you survive long enough to use them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/0e741c52403d53dbc93550b5a418e21be0de1d4e.png"][/img][/p][h2]BIOBOOST[/h2][p]Death is not failure. Death is data.[/p][p]If you fall in battle, you’ll restart from the beginning of the current act. But don’t worry, your [b]BioMats carry over[/b], allowing you to permanently [b]enhance your core abilities[/b] between runs.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/cb43eb523a05f8f6fc05477d307454e67a9315ed.png"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be covering the full [b]BioBoost system in detail next Thursday[/b], so stay tuned![/p][p]Thanks for reading! As we build towards launch we have a lot of exciting content coming. Be sure to [url="https://discord.gg/srct46r9uv"]join our Discord server[/url] to get the earliest updates and exclusive news![/p][p][/p][p]See you in the stars 💫  [/p][p]- Pixel Reign 🚀  [/p][p][/p][h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #13 - Weapons and Augments #4
notes.content:
[b][i]Know your enemy! That's a core tenet of being an Orphean. Whether you're fighting Freorra Corpos or alien threats, you must understand them. And what better way than to use their own weapons against them.[/i][/b]

[h2]Weapons & Augments #4[/h2]
We've loved all the support you've given us thoroughout our recent playtests, however, there's still plenty of weapons & augments you haven't seen! Let's talk about some of them today.

[h2]WEAPONS[/h2]
[h3]Absolver ⚔️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/cd6094ae70b3643abf64b39a2184af8233bcbf0b.png[/img]
A mechanical chainsaw blade designes specifically for cutting tough flesh and bones. Standard Catharis anti-darkphage weapon.

[h3]Burning Heat🔫[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/1617816c96f78086bc387b4d1525c45970f4df88.png[/img]
Originally created by a cook with a passion for burning things, this makeshift flamethrower is now a classic DIY recipe found in space web, which you can quickly make with things you find in a spaceship kitchen.

[h2]AUGMENTS[/h2]
[h3]Bloody Aid ⬆️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/e19a4ab1c4f098fa79bbf804bafad747204ab460.png[/img]
The monsters of the Darkphage are snappy and vicious. The likelyhood of getting slashed, bitten and shot are very high. However, this isn't all negative. If you pick up an augment like Bloody Aid, you turn 25% of damage received is fills your healing shot meter every time you get hit.

[h3]Stay Healthy ⬆️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/3eb574c1094743ee856155b1e36d1316e680051a.png[/img]
Healthy Melee & Healthy Weapons are upgrades for the masters of doding. If you believe you can keep your health at full, then these augments are for you. When at full HP, increase Melee weapon damage by 60% or increase Ranged weapon damage by 50% respectively.

Thanks for reading through! We're very excited to announce that our [b]FINAL Playtest[/b] kicks off tomorrow at 4pm BST. Get ready to fight through even more of the Orpheus past the Jocaste fight. See you in the stars 💫

notes.title: Dev Diary #12 - Acantha X vs Freorra Industries
notes.content: [p][b][i]"The light that gleams from the star of Centurion shines brightly off our swords. We look towards our galaxy with ease, knowing it was carved for us. Those arms that line our side blast through enemy weakness. We are the strength, we are the power and we are the universe itself. Utopia is nigh, brothers, and Acantha X will carry us there."[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]- Acantha First Sgt. Luke Martin, before the Battle of Centurion 12X394[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Discover [i]Acantha X[/i][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/62b48a62f812fbba9c9c0bad3e5e16b3f301d139.gif"][/img]One of the oldest entities in the cosmos, historians struggle to track their journey as they jumped from planet to planet. Its weaponry was seeded across wars, wherever there was a fight, [i]Acantha X[/i] was there. Eventually, battles became about who could gain its favor. Few companies could stand up to them. Now, in a universe where guns and swords reign supreme, [i]Acantha X[/i] stands as the herald of a new order.[/p][p]Their beliefs are simple: to forge a universal utopia. Followers embrace this vision as sacred doctrine, even if the company distances itself from religious scripture. [i]Moros Protocol[/i] takes place aboard an [i]Acantha X[/i] Capital-class battleship, [i]The Orpheus[/i], on its way to support a ferocious battle against another mega-corporation...[/p][p][/p][h2][i]Freorra Industries[/i][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/5c118dca189bbac0d12436e17bca28d6671d3c3c.png"][/img]The only corporation capable of standing toe-to-toe with [i]Acantha X[/i] is [i]Freorra Industries[/i]. While both believe in a “brighter future for all,” their visions diverge dramatically. What began as an interstellar pharmaceutical firm is now a universe-spanning conglomerate. There are many more corporations like them, but none hold a true stake in the galaxy.[/p][p][i]Freorra[/i] [i]Industries[/i] is your first enemy - you’ll face them in the tutorial of [i]Moros Protocol[/i]. But in the full game, they’re no longer the threat. That title belongs to the [i]Darkphage[/i]...a monstrous force neither corporation dares confront.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, and we look forward to seeing you next week![/p][p]See you in the stars 💫[/p][p] - Pixel Reign 🚀  [/p][p][/p][h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2][p]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #11 - How to Play
notes.content:
[p][i][b]The universe is a horrifying place. Your only chance is to align yourself with one of the major corporations and hope they protect you. But if you find yourself stranded in the darkness - alone - there isn't much that can save you.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][h1][b]How to Play Moros Protocol[/b][/h1][p]Stranded on a decaying warship, stalked by horrors, and guided by a voice you don't recognize, you must adapt, upgrade and push forward. You may be outnumbered, but you are not outmatched. This is Moros Protocol. In this Dev Diary, we're going to break down the core goals of the game, how to play and what you should expect when you jump into the Steam Next Fest Demo. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]GOAL[/b] [/h3][p]You start a run and try to progress as far as possible while gathering resources and becoming stronger. If you defeat the boss of your current area, you’ll unlock the next wing of the ship... and uncover more of the story. If you die, you lose all current progress except for [i]BioMats[/i] which you can use to unlock permanent upgrades. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]ENVIRONMENT[/b][/h3][p][i]Moros Protocol[/i] combines handcrafted level design with procedural generation in order to achieve the feel of human-made environments with the variety of a procedural generated world. Each wing is split into multiple sectors, where after clearing a sector you can choose your next destination giving him the freedom to plan his path to reach the goal. Sectors can have visible modifiers that affect the levels inside them.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/ee5170f4d9c403e87ba79d543e2ce4cc4a4c5ae2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]COMBAT[/b] [/h3][p]While exploring the [i]Orpheus[/i], you will encounter monsters called [i]Darkphage[/i]. If you enter a room with enemies, the ship will activate "Lockdown Mode" forcing you to defeat all threats before letting you move further. Master the dodge mechanic to evade deadly attacks. It’s not just “strafe and shoot”, combat demands timing, positioning, and aggression.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/59b9eb9755709e23f9249f20314628d6321a217e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]WEAPONS & AUGMENTS [/b][/h3][p]The main factor that affects the combat gameplay are the weapons; you can carry one melee and two ranged weapons. Weapons are split into 3 categories: [b]Melee[/b], [b]Energy[/b], and [b]Physical[/b].  Melee weapons consume stamina while Ranged weapons use their respective ammo pool. Besides the stats and gameplay, each weapon can have a different level and rarity. Finding rarer or higher level weapons will increase the combat effectiveness. The player can increase the weapon level at certain vendors, but the rarity cannot be changed - making rare drops highly valuable.[/p][p]Augments are upgrades for your armor and weapons that enhance or change your fighting style. They range from simple passive buffs like higher max health or speed increase, to gameplay altering ones like double jump or changing your weapon power. There is a great variety of augments in the game and they contribute to the uniqueness of each run. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/8bd501180bdfc5e860464e13f4ac88bd2cb44059.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]STEAM NEXT FEST[/b] DEMO[/h3][p]After multiple playtests, our new and improved [i]Moros Protocol[/i] demo is finally live on Steam. Here you can travel through the [i]Orpheus[/i] trying to find out what happened. Guided by the System, you journey through the ship fighting the mysterious monsters known as the [i]Darkphage[/i]. Finally, you find yourself against [i]Big Brother,[/i] an advanced creature created by the [i]Darkphage[/i]. If you manage to defeat it, then you have some more surprises in store. Keep fighting, and get further into the ship in this free demo now available on Steam until [b]16th June[/b]!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/58f0dd788727f896197e55a902e4e14b7905482e.gif"][/img] [/p][p]Thanks for reading, and thank you for your support.[/p][p]Try the demo and let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p]See you in the stars 💫[/p][p]- Pixel Reign 🚀  [/p][p][/p][h2]Be sure to wishlist👇[/h2][p]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1605250/Moros_Protocol/

[/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary #8 - What the Darkphage Leaves Behind
notes.content:
[b][i]It has seeded the infinite void with denizens of hatred. It waits in silence, until the pride of mankind demands correction. Unfettered, it brings lasting equality through annihilation. It is destruction incarnate. It is the Darkphage.[/i][/b]

[h2]Echoes in the Dark[/h2]
Something unnatural has taken hold aboard the Orpheus. Its crew changed, Its corridors stalked by things that shouldn’t exist. Today, we're revealing some of the threats you'll encounter in [i][b]Moros Protocol[/b][/i].

[h3]Larvae[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/c151367a30c02160145b92380fd66d3b558753f1.png[/img]

These creatures scuttle through the Orpheus with an unsettling purpose; seeking out the living. Small and fragile at first, they’re easy to dispatch... but don’t get comfortable. The longer they persist, the more they change. And the more dangerous they become.

[h3]Twisted Orpheans[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/f143cb39a5bf797523032e532ee2a69eb729fb3c.png[/img]

Once-human figures now roam the halls, grotesquely altered. They move with brute force but sluggish steps, as if dragged by something within. Their glowing chests may hint at a weakness, but facing them means confronting what your crewmates have become.

[h3]Nychoraptors[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/50ec194179fab53b1da500140eaaa4f782014ee0.png[/img]

These creatures no longer resemble anything from the Orpheus. Fast, vicious, and disturbingly agile, they are the stuff of nightmares. Watch for the glint of an eye where one should never be... targeting it may be your only chance.

Thank you for reading, and get ready for our playtest this weekend. You might want to grab a friend as co-op kicks off tomorrow! See you in the stars 💫

notes.title: Dev Diary #7 - Meet ODY-6

notes.title: Dev Diary #6 - Weapons and Augments #2
notes.content:
[b][i]Know your enemy! That's a core tenet of being an Orphean. Whether you're fighting Freorra Corpos or alien threats, you must understand them. And what better way than to use their own weapons against them.[/i][/b]

Good day, Orpheans!

There's even more weapons and augments to talk about in today's developer diary! We're going to focus on using the enemy against itself and picking up some corrupted weaponry.

[h2]WEAPONS[/h2]
The Orpheus is crawling with unknown enemies. But it's not all doom and gloom! Use their own bodies against them with these weapons 🩸

[h3]Bonesaw ⚔️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/52d976cf7ff008e8ea4b4189ec9218b5f9dc6167.png[/img]
A sharp jawbone from a Darkphage with remarkable toughness. Its convenient shape makes it an effective close-combat weapon.

[h3]Spitclaw 🔫[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/e5b026de50840484cb328f731816e2abb7599f85.png[/img]
An energy-generating gland from a Darkphage, it can manipulate magnetic fields to create and propel balls of plasma. It seems to be able to sustain itself if given enough food. Recently seen in our playtest—did you get a chance to play with it?

[h3]Bonespitter 🔫[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/0f8eb5adfa202361699108949fe61c59503c6650.png[/img]
This grotesque mass of organs is capable of propelling bone-like projectiles at devastating speeds, inflating its lung and releasing the gas with immense pressure.

[h2]AUGMENTS[/h2]
Last time we talked about augments that improved your health and stamina. Now, we're going to look at some augments that actively give you new abilities throughout your run.

[h3]Dodge Defence ⬆️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/4310bf02f7a262fdc9278aa2346f183305fabf69.png[/img]
Your dodge is a powerful tool. When a Darkphage infectant is swinging its failing arms toward your torso, you need to get out of the way. However, there's more to your dodge with these augments. Like Aftershock, which drops a mini time bomb when you dodge, and Static Discharge, which leaves an electric field in your wake. However, be careful, as these extra abilities are going to increase your dodge stamina cost.

[h3]Keep it Moving ⬆️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/02d9d042c305b3ef6ed2497b25add979c901f3c9.png[/img]
Increase your player speed with augments like Kinetic Boosters and Scout Boots. This will make it much harder for the Darkphage to take you down. Then combine these abilities with Run n Gun to increase weapon damage by up to 160% while moving. Become a speed machine and a blur of bullets!

You will be able to find some of these weapons and more in the upcoming playtest this weekend (starting tomorrow, the 9th of May). Be sure to sign up once it goes live at 4 PM BST. See you in the stars 💫

notes.title: Dev Diary #5 - The Orpheus
notes.content:
[i][b]Assistance Request - The Orpheus
We’ve called in one of Acantha X’s Capital-class battleships to break the stalemate. Freorra’s forces are numerous, their attacks relentless, our lines won’t hold much longer. The Orpheus should have left Hyperspace by now. It’s carrying much-needed reinforcements, along with enough munitions and supplies to turn the tide... without them, we’ve lost. Where is that damn ship?[/b][/i]

[b]Inside the Orpheus[/b]
[i]Moros Protocol[/i] takes place aboard the [i]Orpheus[/i], [i]Acantha X’s[/i] colossal deep-space warship. Today, we’re peeling back the hull plating and giving you a look at its history, purpose, and what it means for the war effort.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/857baef77843fc29191c3fd6bc182e58ee84141c.png[/img]
The [i]Orpheus[/i] is a [i]Capital Battleship[/i]; a mobile fortress-city designed to carry [b]millions of cryo-slept troops[/b] across the stars. It’s outfitted with cutting-edge weaponry, training grounds, agriculture domes, and a fleet of escort ships. In short, [b]it’s a symbol of [i]Acantha X[/i]’s military dominance[/b].

Now, with the war against [i]Freorra Industries[/i] locked in a [b]brutal deadlock[/b], both sides are growing desperate. Rumors swirl that [i]Acantha X[/i] is preparing to deploy a [i]classified weapon[/i] to force an end to the conflict. But with tensions escalating and every second counting, [b]all eyes are on the Orpheus[/b].

Will it arrive in time to tip the scales?
[i]And just how far is Acantha X willing to go in the name of victory?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/5972bc275e611e929875ff59fdf88d0940434e31.png[/img]
Thanks for reading, and we can’t wait for you to explore the [i]Orpheus[/i] during our upcoming playtests.

[i]See you in the stars,[/i]✨
[b]— Pixel Reign 🚀[/b]

notes.content:
[b][i]You have to have faith that he will protect you. Because when the chips are down, he's the only bet I'd make.[/i][/b]

Good day, Orpheans!

In [i]Moros Protocol[/i], you play as the last remaining soldier aboard the deep-space vessel, the [i]Orpheus[/i]. His name is Alex, and he might just be the universe’s last hope.

Alex wakes up from cryo-sleep. [i]System[/i] guides him through the now-abandoned spaceship. As he explores, he discovers a robot called [i]ODY-6[/i]. It doesn’t take long before he realizes something is wrong. There’s an infection on the ship that he needs to survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/608eca7972d3fc91c7fdd244355913c884f27e27.png[/img]

Alex is one of many Orpheans who were meant to protect the ship. Except something within the cryopod went wrong. After waking up, his memories and skills seem to have completely disappeared. Now, he goes against a mysterious alien infection known only as the Darkphage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/dc4d6d39456256def080d70564c90cd62b191a2e.png[/img]

Eventually, Alex learns that [i]System[/i] is what’s keeping him alive. Alex gains clarity (and new abilities each time he wakes up), he dives deeper into the heart of the [i]Orpheus[/i] to uncover the truth and stop the [i]Darkphage[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/65ce1ab67f3f678d89804d6df27627451709d12e.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Who are we?
notes.content:
[b][i]The hardest thing about Deep Space? Sometimes you hear a creak or a snap in a random part of the ship, and the only person you have to blame is an engineer a million miles away. That and the constant barrage of alien lifeforms trying to rip you apart.[/i][/b]

Good day, Orpheans!

Thank you for all your support throughout our recent update. We're so excited to finally bring Moros Protocol in 2025. There's so much to talk about while we build to the final version of the game... so, we plan to do weekly dev diaries [b]every single Thursday![/b] This means you'll get insights into development and leave suggestions to help us shape Moros Protocol into the deep space boomer shooter of your dreams.

Today, we're going to talk about the team behind the game, [i]Pixel Reign[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/d18d263cc98f2aa33b19b72e8d984e7e2e10af3f.png[/img]

The studio was founded in 2018, however, Nick Larin the founder has been working on games since 1999. Nick worked as developer for "Darkfall 2: The Unholy Wars".  He then worked on many mobile games (most of them not online anymore). Pixel Reign started with the creation of a game named [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/718010/Robbie_Swifthand_and_the_Orb_of_Mysteries/]Robbie Swifthand[/url]. They collaborated with a Greek mobile studio to make Neonverse. After that, tons of mobile games again as B2B (dark times) while slowly starting the Darkverse project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/32893031fc3cf37c96df8a7262df6a5cadee1b68.png[/img]

Darkverse was a personal project Nick worked on 2009-2011, A 2.5d spaceship game which was never finished.  You can watch some footage from the original game here!

[previewyoutube=ea53YFrJsek;full][/previewyoutube]

But the story and world were fleshed out, so the team decided to create a game in the same universe as a prologue to that game. That's how Darkverse: Rogue came to be, which is now Moros Protocol. 

Moros Protocol started as a side project back in 2019, while the team were working on external projects to help sustain the studio. Around September 2022 we were able to focus more on the project and we slowly were fleshing out the version you saw last year. Now, with the help of Super Rare Originals, the team has grown!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/345a68125a67c0909bd729d8ba198afdbe10961f.png[/img]

When asked what he was most excited for players to jump into, Nick said this
[i]"Personally I just love when people get to experience a world I created or worked on, and see how they approach everything in their own way. This is something you can only do in videogames, where you see others literally "live" through an experience you created."[/i]

We're so excited for Moros Protocol to release later this year! We look forward to seeing you next week for another Dev Diary!

[h2]Upcoming Playtests[/h2]
We announced last week that we plan to have consistent playtests on the road to launch. Those will kick off very soon right here on Steam. We'll release a full schedule into our discord very soon (will update Steam later). Be sure to join our discord to get the latest updates on Steam Playtests and an easy place to leave feedback for the devs and find fellow Orpheans to get hype.

Thanks for reading! See you in the stars

- Pixel Reign 🚀

notes.title: 🎮🎄 A Holiday Update & A New Name 🎄🎮
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Darkverse: Rogue fans![/h2]

As we head into the holiday season, we have some exciting news to share. After much thought and reflection, we’ve decided to rename our game. This new name ties deeply into the game’s lore and our creative vision.

[i]Moros[/i], in Greek mythology, is the personification of impending doom and fate—a force that no one can escape. It’s a concept that perfectly reflects the tension and stakes at the heart of our game. This change also honours our Greek heritage of our team and the mythological inspiration that’s been a guiding light for the project.

The new name of the game shall be...
[h1]Moros Protocol[/h1]

While this year has been a quieter one for updates, rest assured that [i]Moros Protocol[/i] has been evolving into something truly special. We’ve been working tirelessly behind the scenes to refine the game and bring our vision to life.

Mark your calendars, because 2025 is going to be an incredible year for us—and for you, our players. A big announcement is on the horizon, and we can’t wait to share what’s next.

From everyone on the team, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a wonderful holiday season. Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to embark on this new chapter together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42294246/3e9cb742917fe97eb696fc1eaa6ca62c694561dc.png[/img]

Stay safe,
The Pixel Reign Team
